headline: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited: Agreements
sum: Agreements - Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Joint Venture Agreement has been executed between Carnation Hotels Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and RJ Corp Limited with respect to Arum…
detail: Agreements - Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Joint Venture Agreement has been executed between Carnation Hotels Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and RJ Corp Limited with respect to Arum Hotels Private Limited, the Special Purpose Vehicle and step-down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, for the development and execution of the Aurika Shillong project.
